selection_metric: validation MAE in original SOH percentage points
notes: Sequential search, not a full factorial design; validation is reused for selection.
Batch size 256 is fixed for every model; selected for practical CPU training, not tuned from validation.
Xavier uniform gain=1 and zero biases for all activations; linear single output.
Epoch experiment uses endpoints of one uninterrupted 200-epoch trajectory with early stopping disabled.
Test arrays are not loaded by the experiment runner; final test evaluation belongs to notebook 04.
Domain feature engineering is deferred; existing preprocessing recipes are compared first.
